name: OtaMaid Mai
source:
Train your cheeky little sister into the perfect Otaku Maid!

How will your sister change?
An anime otaku? Moe otaku? Or perhaps a BL loving fujoshi...?
Perhaps even an idol? Train her to your tastes and enjoy how things turn out!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE167591.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
把你厚脸皮的妹妹培养成完美的御宅族女仆！

姐姐会有怎样的改变呢？
动漫御宅族？萌宅男？或者也许是一个喜欢BL的腐女……？
也许甚至是偶像？按照你的口味训练她并享受事情的结果！
